title: International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy Nutrition
excerpt: Oats, Greek yogurt, lentils, low-mercury salmon, eggs, leafy greens, and citrus — practical ways to build balanced plates
content:
## Introduction to Pregnancy Nutrition
Pregnancy nutrition plays a crucial role in ensuring the health of both mother and baby. A balanced and varied diet will help provide the necessary nutrients for fetal development. In this article, we will explore international pantry staples that are good for pregnant women, helping to build balanced and safe meals.

## Analysis of International Pantry Staples for Pregnant Women
The following international pantry staples are considered good for pregnant women:
- Oats: rich in fiber, helping to support digestive health and reduce the risk of constipation.
- Greek yogurt: rich in calcium, helping to support the development of bones and teeth in the fetus.
- Lentils: rich in protein, fiber, and iron, helping to support fetal development and reduce the risk of anemia.
- Low-mercury salmon: rich in omega-3 fatty acids, helping to support the development of the brain and eyes in the fetus.
- Eggs: rich in protein, vitamins, and minerals, helping to support fetal development.
- Leafy greens and citrus: rich in vitamins and minerals, helping to support the immune system and reduce the risk of disease.

## How to Combine International Pantry Staples into Meals
To combine international pantry staples into meals, you can try the following:
- Add oats to breakfast with Greek yogurt and fruit.
- Use lentils to make stews or salads.
- Cook low-mercury salmon with leafy greens and citrus to create a balanced meal.
- Add eggs to breakfast or lunch to increase protein intake.

## Practical Tips for Pregnant Women
To ensure food safety during pregnancy, you should:
- Wash your hands thoroughly before preparing meals.
- Wash leafy greens and fruit thoroughly before using.
- Cook food to a safe temperature to avoid the risk of food poisoning.
- Avoid eating foods with a high risk of food poisoning, such as sushi, sashimi, raw meat, or raw eggs.

## When to Seek Help
If you have any questions or concerns about pregnancy nutrition, you should seek help from a doctor or a registered dietitian. They can provide you with specific advice and guidance to ensure you and your baby receive the necessary nutrients.

## Sources of Information
To learn more about pregnancy nutrition and international pantry staples for pregnant women, you can visit [our website](/planner) or [read articles on our blog](/blog/topics).

## Conclusion
Pregnancy nutrition is an essential part of ensuring the health of both mother and baby. By combining international pantry staples into meals, you can help provide the necessary nutrients for fetal development. Remember to always wash your hands, wash leafy greens and fruit, cook food to a safe temperature, and avoid eating foods with a high risk of food poisoning. If you have any questions or concerns, seek help from a doctor or a registered dietitian.
